aggregation: unweighted mean of five evidence-completeness components

normalization.evidence: reported and normalized values remain linked in observations.csv

provenance.evidence: record_id and source_id are retained in database, map and anomaly outputs

quality_control.evidence: censoring, invalid coordinates and batch status are explicit

source_integrity.evidence: one of two source files failed SHA-256 verification and was excluded

spatial.evidence: valid coordinates are mapped; no external geologic-unit join was supplied

interpretation: Workflow confidence summarizes auditable evidence completeness; it is not a probability that a measurement or anomaly is scientifically true.
